[RLOW.11.6] **The checks are the language's.** The compiler must refuse,
before it lowers anything, every program the language trees refuse, by
[LERR.1.1.11]'s criterion, and must report each refusal with the code its
clause names. This document adds one refusal of its own, a rule the compiler
cannot lower ([RLOW.1.6]). The rule-graph cycle check is [LCYC.3]'s, reported
as `DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE` ([LCYC.6.1.1]); a construct the program's settings
forbid is refused per [RLOW.10.1.1].
